title: 第64章 战斗正酣下谅山
content_zh:
第64章 战斗正酣下谅山-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》
上一章
存书签
下一章
奇穷河在越南的防线中具有重要的地位，它首先分割了谅山，形成南北两个城区。只要谅山没被完全拿下，越南就认为还有希望。自古就有“下谅山而越王降”的说法。
第二，奇穷河的南岸是高地，北岸虽然失守，但是南岸仍然可以居高临下地阻击我军的机械化兵团。
第三，跨过奇穷河，拿下南岸迷迈山，眼前便是开阔的平原，坦克可直扑河内。
所以，当部队拿下奇穷河北岸后。越南仍在吹嘘“奇穷河防线固若金汤”，解放军攻不下谅山南区等等。
真是走夜路吹口哨，给自己壮胆呢！
之所以在3月3日渡江之后接到紧急暂停渡河的命令，是因为55军在同登、谅山等地构筑了包围圈，不断吸引越军支援，消灭一批越军有生精锐。
一旦强渡成功，同登那边的包围圈能吸引过去的敌军就有限了，甚至正在增援途中的部队都有可能撒丫子跑路。
等到同登方面差不多了，127师再次强渡奇穷河，准备拿下迷迈山阻击敌人接下来的增援。
强渡一开始，各型号的大炮和火箭炮就如冰雹般朝着南岸的阵地砸了过去，主攻团冒着炮火渡河。
379团只有一营的任务是渡河，二营和三营的主要任务是阻敌增援，在左岸阻止敌人增援谅山和迷迈山。
主攻团拿下南岸的高地迷迈山之后，就地转入防御。
因为越南人在迷迈山地区布下了重兵和雷区，所以打起来比之前更为艰难。
师部跟随380团行动，因为太过靠近前沿，指挥车还遭到了小股部队的攻击，所幸师部无恙。
全师听到这个消息，都为章师长捏了一把汗！
最近，越南人天天喊着活捉章师长的口号，对这位能征善战的将领可谓是恨之入骨。
“营部命令，让我们九连前出攻击，拿下前面的高地，跟七连、八连形成形成三角防御阵地。”通讯员说道。
马贵生二话不说，集合队伍就出发：“走！”
九连战士迅速行动，朝着无名高地攻去。九连之前已经多次打退连级规模的冲锋，部队的伤亡和消耗较为严重。此时继续前出攻击，对整个连队来说无疑又是一次重大的考验。
“不行啊，前面是雷区，敌人又用机枪封锁了。”连长马贵生把帽子往后一拨，疯狂朝前面开火。
看着旁边受伤的战士，刘济民喊道：“快，把受伤的抬到掩体后面，担架！”

Chapter 64 The battle is raging in Lang Son - "Literary Hero 1978: Beginning as a Military Writer"

Chi Chung River plays an important role in Vietnam's defense line. It first divided Lang Son and formed two urban areas in the north and south. As long as Lang Son is not completely captured, Vietnam believes there is still hope. Since ancient times, there has been a saying of "going down to Langshan and crossing over to the king's surrender".
Second, the south bank of the Qiqiong River is a highland. Although the north bank is lost, the south bank can still block our mechanized corps from a high position.
Third, cross the Qiqiong River and capture the Mimai Mountain on the south bank. There is an open plain in front of you, and the tanks can go straight into Hanoi.
Therefore, when the troops captured the north bank of Qiqiong River. Vietnam is still boasting that the "Qi Qiong River defense line is impregnable" and that the People's Liberation Army cannot capture the southern district of Lang Son, etc.
It’s really like whistling at night to embolden yourself!
The reason why they received an emergency order to suspend crossing the river after crossing the river on March 3 was because the 55th Army built encirclements in Dong Dang, Lang Son and other places, constantly attracted support from the Vietnamese army, and eliminated a group of elite Vietnamese soldiers.
Once the forced crossing is successful, the encirclement on Tongdeng's side will be limited in attracting enemy troops, and even troops on the way to reinforcements may run away.
When Tongdeng was almost done, the 127th Division once again forcibly crossed the Qiqiong River, preparing to capture Mimai Mountain to block the enemy's next reinforcements.
As soon as the forced crossing began, artillery and rocket launchers of various types rained down on the positions on the south bank like hailstones, and the main attack group braved artillery fire to cross the river.
Only the first battalion of the 379th Regiment was tasked with crossing the river, while the second and third battalions were mainly tasked with blocking enemy reinforcements and preventing enemy reinforcements on the left bank from Lang Son and Mimai Mountains.
After the main attack group captured Mimai Mountain, a highland on the south coast, it switched to defense on the spot.
Because the Vietnamese laid heavy troops and minefields in the Mimai Mountain area, the fight was more difficult than before.
The division headquarters followed the 380th Regiment. Because it was too close to the front line, the command vehicle was attacked by a small group of troops. Fortunately, the division headquarters was unharmed.
When the whole division heard the news, they were all sweating for Master Zhang!
Recently, the Vietnamese have shouted slogans to capture Commander Zhang alive every day, and they hate this general who is good at conquering and fighting.
"The battalion headquarters ordered our Ninth Company to attack forward, capture the high ground in front, and form a triangular defense position with the Seventh and Eighth Companies," the correspondent said.
Without saying a word, Ma Guisheng gathered the team and set off: "Let's go!"
The soldiers of the Ninth Company moved quickly and attacked the unknown high ground. The Ninth Company had repelled company-sized charges many times before, and the casualties and attrition of the troops were relatively serious. Continuing to attack at this time will undoubtedly be another major test for the entire company.
"No, there is a minefield ahead, and the enemy has blocked it with machine guns." Company Commander Ma Guisheng pushed back his hat and fired wildly forward.
Looking at the injured soldier next to him, Liu Jimin shouted: "Quick, carry the injured behind the bunker on a stretcher!"
